    <script><![CDATA[// Legacy (non-module) business-rule script for the Intent to Fill case table.
//
// Loaded into the "ITF Set Defaults and Route" business rule via Now.include().
// Modules (import/export) are not supported in a configuration-type SDK project,
// so this uses the platform-injected globals (current, previous, gs, GlideRecord).
//
// Runs `before insert`:
//   1. Builds a default short_description when the requester left it blank.
//   2. Looks up the agency-to-analyst routing record for the case department and
//      pre-populates the executive approver and the assigned OPM analyst.
// Never calls current.update() — this is a before rule.

if (!current.getValue('short_description')) {
    current.setValue(
        'short_description',
        'Intent to Fill - ' +
            current.getValue('u_job_title') +
            ' (' +
            current.getValue('u_position_number') +
            ')',
    );
}

var routing = new GlideRecord('x_snc_sas_positi_0_routing');
routing.addQuery('u_department', current.getValue('u_department'));
routing.query();
if (routing.next()) {
    if (!current.getValue('u_exec_approver')) {
        current.setValue('u_exec_approver', routing.getValue('u_exec_approver'));
    }
    var opmAnalyst = routing.getValue('u_opm_analyst');
    if (opmAnalyst) {
        current.setValue('assigned_to', opmAnalyst);
    }
}
]]></script>
    <sys_name>ITF Set Defaults and Route</sys_name>
    <sys_policy/>
    <template/>
    <when>before</when>
  </sys_script>
